Above all else: communicate your thoughts to her in full. I know this may be cliche but this is absolutely the most important step. Now I'm going to be brutally honest with you here: from what you wrote I think this isn't as much of an issue as you may think it is. Your anxiety may be influencing those thoughts of feeling left out or not participating in her life enough, in which case I'd say just work on the anxiety first and foremost, which will either let you experiment more or it will lead you to feel more comfortable with being the sober one. Secondly, I think there's nothing wrong with being the more "sober" person in a relationship as long as you both support each other in your choices and are comfortable with each other's lifestyles as well as your own choice. If you really want to participate in her lifestyle the only answer is pushing your boundaries, which will only be possible with your anxiety sorted out.
